name: Header Generator
description: Generate a set of client request headers for a platform and version, with optional custom headers.

hints.platform: The first version supports built-in platforms and custom input only; no online UA lookup is used.
hints.customHeaders: One per line, in `Name: Value` format.

faq.q: Can these headers bypass risk controls?
faq.a: No. It is only a template of common headers for debugging and compatibility testing.

faq.q: Can the version and operating system be left empty?
faq.a: Yes. The built-in defaults for the platform are used; fill them in only when a specific version matters.

faq.q: Why are custom headers sorted alphabetically?
faq.a: So the same set of custom headers always produces the same order, which makes comparison and copying easier.
